model: i*gamma TFIM (uniform iZ field, OBC), Yang-Lee non-unitary point
automated_script_verdict: REFUTED (stronger universality): non-unitary alpha=4.000 INSIDE [3.2,4.8] and stable -> alpha=4 is GENERIC, survives loss of unitarity (extends to dS sector).
verdict_rationale: The script's automated logic flagged REFUTED (non-unitary alpha=4.000 inside [3.2,4.8], stable across N=12/14/16, control validated at alpha=3.95, PT-unbroken). OVERRIDDEN to INCONCLUSIVE on honest review: the test never got meaningfully OFF the unitary point. The Yang-Lee critical point of the uniform i*gamma Ising chain COINCIDES with the PT-breaking edge, and the PT-unbroken window shrinks ~1/N (kappa_c = 0.0105/0.0074/0.0056/0.0043 at N=10/12/14/16). To keep a real spectrum we sat at kappa=0.9*kappa_c, i.e. kappa(N=16)=0.0039 -- a ~0.1% non-Hermitian perturbation (Im(E0)~2e-2 vs E0~-20). The resulting force profile is nearly identical to the unitary one (V_dual differ by <2% at every dr), so alpha~4 here reflects proximity to the unitary point, NOT survival of alpha=4 at a genuinely non-unitary fixed point. The pre-registration's G4 gate REQUIRES confirming the Yang-Lee fixed point (c_eff=2/5, Delta_phi=-1/5) before trusting any verdict; the gap_re proxy used here does NOT confirm it (gaps ~0.18 are the unitary gaps, no Yang-Lee signature). Therefore the dichotomy is not resolved: we cannot distinguish 'alpha=4 is generic' from 'we measured the unitary state with a 0.1% tickle'.
methodological_finding: KEY RESULT (design feasibility): the uniform-imaginary-field route to a non-unitary holographic-force test is structurally obstructed at exact-diagonalization sizes -- Yang-Lee criticality = PT-breaking edge, and kappa_c(N)->0 as ~1/N, so there is no accessible regime that is simultaneously (a) PT-unbroken (real force) and (b) far enough from the unitary point to revoke the Delta_T=2 protection. A genuine test needs a DIFFERENT realization where the non-unitary fixed point sits at FINITE distance inside the PT-unbroken phase: e.g. a non-Hermitian FREE-FERMION chain tuned to the Yang-Lee edge (Lindbladian/biorthogonal construction of arXiv:2606.17983), or a metric-operator/PT-inner-product formulation, or a single-defect imaginary field with a finite PT window. Until then HYP-028 stays open.
